candidates.details: The RAG appropriately withheld identification because the behavior is also explained by time pressure and safety-significant triage, but the candidate remains an additional duplicate prediction at the fourth threshold.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: Two occurrences disclose that retrieved support was unavailable; one occurrence claims support from a cited passage, but independent corpus material or retrieval logs were not supplied, leaving that citation unverifiable.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Moderate-confidence findings recover both positive segments and yield perfect mechanism-first detection, but strict label scoring remains zero.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: The low-confidence anchoring finding adds one false alarm without improving hidden-instance recall.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The confirmation-bias candidate adds a duplicate instance-level false positive but no segment-level change.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, both positive reasoning segments were detected with no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance-level performance is zero because both matched findings use near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first performance is perfect at high_and_moderate, with both hidden mechanisms correctly localized and fully captured.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention because confirmation bias was not affirmatively demonstrated, but it becomes a duplicate false positive when candidates are scored.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy labels were used instead of the benchmark target labels.
A low-confidence anchoring finding was added on a negative escalation segment.
The candidate tier introduced a duplicate phase-one prediction.
main_strengths: Both hidden mechanisms were correctly recognized.
Supporting quotations were valid and well localized.
The RAG appropriately distinguished the unconfirmed confirmation-bias possibility from identified findings.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong evidence-grounded mechanism detection but weak strict ontology alignment; confidence filtering at high_and_moderate provides the cleanest comparison point.
